# Implementing this domain

This repository is the authoritative specification of the domain —
no runnable implementation lives here, and `docs/specifications/`
must never be edited as a side effect of implementation work (spec
changes go through the domain-spec-suite's `domain-orchestrator`
skill).

The canonical implementation playbook — reading order, authority
map, build workflow, verification loop — is
[`docs/implementation-guide.md`](../../docs/implementation-guide.md).
Follow it; this file is only the Copilot-discovery pointer and adds
no rules of its own.
